Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call - next steps and scheduling

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call earlier — really appreciate the time. Quick recap from my side:
- You’re interested in a Dedicated deployment to support your high-throughput inference use case (customer-facing chat + batch reranking).
- Key objectives: sub-200ms p95 generation latency for single-request flows, and sustained throughput of ~120 QPS for the model family we discussed.

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on traffic profile, sample payloads, and runway for autoscaling/burst. For that call we typically bring an infra lead (to discuss network, VPC/KMS) and one of our server-side engineers to map throughput/latency targets to GPU pools and batching/quantization options.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Jun 29, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Jun 30, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Jun 30, 3:00–3:45pm

Can you confirm which of these works for you and whether you’ll include your infra/security lead? I attached our capacity template which helps us prepare sizing estimates in advance (please fill if you can).

Agenda (draft, attached):
- 10m: goals & traffic profile
- 20m: throughput/latency targets and architecture assumptions
- 10m: sizing recommendations and next steps
- 5m: follow-ups and action items

Thanks — if you prefer I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a time.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Perfect — Wed Jun 30 at 10:00am PT is confirmed on our side. I’ve added David (infra/ops) and Camila (solutions engineer) to the thread; they’ll lead the sizing and tech walkthrough. I’ll send the calendar invite now.

Short answers to your questions:
- Deployment variants: we typically propose a primary model variant tuned for your quality/latency goals and a quantized fallback for cost-sensitive or degraded modes; we’ll show how routing/fallbacks work in practice on the call.
- Sample payload assumptions (we’ll validate these with you):
  - Chat: avg 180 tokens in, 220 tokens out (~400 tokens total)
  - Batch reranking: avg 1.2k tokens per request (per item) — effective tokens depend on list length; please supply list length distribution if possible

David/Camila — can you prepare an initial sizing (GPU pool + suggested instance types), and bring any questions about sample payloads or authentication/network constraints (VPC peering, egress)? Also attaching the short agenda PDF for the invite.

Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks — I’ll take point on the sizing artifacts for Wed. Initial checklist for prep: 
- Can FintechCo share sample payloads (anonymized) or a small sample of chat requests and reranking lists? The capacity template helps, but raw payloads let us model batching/kv-cache behavior more accurately.
- If you have peak/windowed QPS (e.g., 5-min, 1-hour), send that as well.
- Any networking constraints (VPC peering windows, proxy, IP allowlists) we should be aware of ahead of time?

I’ll prepare two sizing options: (A) steady-state pool to meet 120 QPS at p95 <= 200ms, (B) cost-optimized pool with autoscaling and quantized fallback. Will bring sample perf numbers from a similar fintech customer for reference.

-David
